name: multi-model-review
description: Run capped task-scoped reviews with locked Codex triage, bounded repair rounds, mandatory confirmation, and commit-aware final gates.

interface.longDescription: Codex implements and verifies. Capped Claude, optional Antigravity, and optional Kimi independently inspect immutable repository snapshots in read-only sessions. The workflow pins task scope, bounds repairs, requires final confirmation, records typed provider failures and active status, locks triage, and verifies commit-aware freshness.
defaultPrompt: Review my task-scoped changes with capped Claude, decide every finding and test gap, then complete a mandatory confirmation gate.
Run an independent Claude review with locked triage and verify the resulting commit.
Do a usage-audited multi-repository final review before merge.
